blocks.text: A lawmaker on Tuesday called for continued oversight of all countries that send workers to Korea to ensure foreign nationals are not unfairly penalized by their native countries while working in Korea. The move follows Uzbekistan and Bangladesh pledging to end practices that financially penalized their nationals for changing jobs without home-country approval. During a parliamentary audit of the Ministry of Employment and Labor, Rep. Shin Jeong-hoon of the Democratic Party of Korea urged the government to conduct a comprehensive review and establish a permanent monitoring system.
